integrity.computation_role: finite numerical checks are corroborative and are not used as proof of the infinite asymptotic
integrity.proof_basis: analytic proof from the \(SU(2)\) character formula, normalized Weyl integration, an exact finite trigonometric identity, an explicit logarithmic remainder bound, and Fourier-series averaging

scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the highest-weight low-pass cutoff on \(SU(2)\).
The proved remainder is \(O(\log(L+2))\); optimal lower-order terms are not claimed.
A terminology-adjacent 1986 Bochner-Riesz paper could not be fully inspected and is retained as an originality risk.
title: Exact leading constant for spherical Fourier partial sums on \(SU(2)\)
